 b=p.read_bytes();rows.append({'label':label,'args':args,'exitCode':q.returncode,'seconds':round(time.time()-t,3),'rawPath':str(p.relative_to(r)),'rawSHA256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'rawBytes':len(b)});(s/'control-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps({'commands':rows},indent=2)+'\n');assert q.returncode==0
